text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Debut race. Sweep Tosho 
grew increasingly frustrated with everyone 
constantly worrying over her and fussing 
about.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, right before the race, a 
phone call from her father causes her 
frustration to boil over. Filled with 
anxiety, they ended up sending Sweep Tosho 
off to the track.
